subject: Audit logs export: retention TTL, delivery proofs and deletion attestations
messages:
From: Audits Coordinator <audits@acmehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Audit logs export: retention TTL and delivery proof (Acme Health)

Hi Karthik,

We're preparing for an upcoming SOC review and need to understand Redwood's capabilities for delivering tenant audit/access logs for Acme Health. A few specific asks:

- Can you confirm supported export formats (NDJSON, CSV, Parquet, etc.) and whether logs include event-level metadata (actor, tenant_id, request_id, region, timestamp, model_id)?
- For tenants with EU residency, what retention windows do you export? Is there a hard TTL enforced in-region, and can we request a bulk export covering the last 36 months?
- Do you provide integrity proofs (checksums, manifest files) with exports and a chain-of-custody statement/attestation for deletion after transfer?
- Typical turnaround for a full-tenant export (estimated size ~1.2TB compressed)? Any qualifications for legal hold or redaction requests?

We have a tight audit deadline (end of November). Please let me know the path, expected timelines, and any prerequisites (S3 destination, pre-signed URL, encryption requirements, required PO/contacts).

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Audits Coordinator — Acme Health
alex.morgan@acmehealth.com
Phone: +44 20 5555 1234
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Audits Coordinator <audits@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit logs export: retention TTL and delivery proof (Acme Health)

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. We can support the scenarios you've outlined but need a few details to scope the work and delivery SLA:

1) Tenant identifier (tenant_id) and confirmation the workload is EU-sovereign (you mentioned EU; please confirm EU region and whether data must remain within an EU egress path).
2) Exact time window: you wrote "last 36 months" — confirm start/end dates or whether rolling back from today is OK.
3) Preferred export format (NDJSON is our standard for event streams; we can also deliver Parquet or gzipped CSV).
4) Destination preference: secure S3 bucket (us-east-1 / eu-west-1), encrypted GCS/Azure Blob, or secure FTP. For very large transfers we can arrange an encrypted physical handoff but that requires lead time.

High-level answers to your bullet points now:
- Formats: NDJSON (default), Parquet (columnar), CSV (simple) — event-level metadata is included; request_id and model_id included where applicable.
- Retention/export TTL: retention is configurable per-tenant and per-region. For EU-resident tenants we enforce the tenant retention settings in-region; exports can include all data still retained. We do not export data that has been purged by an enforced TTL unless placed on legal hold prior to purge.
- Integrity & attestations: exports include a delivery manifest, per-file SHA256 checksums, and a signed export attestation PDF describing the export scope and chain-of-custody. We can also provide a deletion attestation after successful handoff that documents deletion timestamps and tombstones.
- Turnaround: ballpark for 1.2TB compressed to S3 is 2–5 business days (fast path) depending on concurrent export load and whether you accept a staged presigned URL delivery. Larger or more regulated transfers (physical encrypted disk, legal-proof packaging) can take 7–10 business days.

I'll draft a short playbook and checklist and loop in Laura (evidence packaging) and Marissa (legal hold process). Can you share the tenant_id and whether you require any PII redaction before export?

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

---

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@acmehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit logs export: retention TTL and delivery proof (Acme Health)

Thanks Karthik — quick answers below.

- Tenant ID: acme-tenant-84
- Region: EU (primary: eu-west-1). Data must not leave the EU during the export process.
- Window: 2024-11-01 through 2026-11-01 (36 months rolling).
- Format: NDJSON preferred.
- Redaction: We may need to request limited redaction for health-identifiable tokens before we hand data off to auditors; if redaction cannot be done in-line, we will accept the export and perform redaction on-prem.
- Delivery: prefer secure S3 in eu-west-1 with server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) and presigned PUTs from your side. We can provide a bucket and KMS key.

We appreciate the manifest and SHA256 checksums. Please confirm the deletion attestation format — we will need a time-stamped signed statement we can attach to our audit kit.

Alex
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Audits Coordinator <audits@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit logs export: retention TTL, delivery proofs and deletion attestations

Alex —

Confirmed on the tenant and region. Below is a consolidated playbook and what to expect; I've attached a short checklist (export_delivery_checklist.xlsx) and the internal runbook snippet (audit_export_options_v2.pdf) for handoff.

Scope & data included
- Export will include event-level audit and access logs for acme-tenant-84 for 2024-11-01 through 2026-11-01. Each event record includes timestamp (ISO8601), actor id, tenant_id, request_id, model_id, event_type, request_path, response_code, and optional payload references.

Export formats & delivery
- Primary delivery format: NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON) compressed with gzip. We will provide an accompanying Parquet export on request for analytical ingestion.
- Delivery methods supported (EU-only path):
  * S3 (eu-west-1) — we can create presigned PUT endpoints or push directly to your bucket using server-side encryption (SSE-KMS).
  * GCS / Azure Blob — supported via customer-provided credentials and endpoints.
  * Secure FTP (SFTP) — available for smaller exports.
  * Physical media — encrypted disk courier (requires 10 business days planning + attestation package).

Integrity & manifests
- Each export bundle contains: file-level SHA256 checksums, a top-level export manifest (JSON) describing files, record counts, compression, and a signed export attestation (PDF) with chain-of-custody notes. We also provide a Merkle-style digest for very large deliveries on request.

Turnaround & sizing
- Estimated window for the requested 1.2TB compressed: 3–6 business days to stage, validate checksums, and finalize attestations when operating under normal load. If you need accelerated delivery we can prioritize for a one-time fee; we will provide a firm ETA after we validate raw size and tenant snapshoted throughput.

Deletion attestation & legal hold
- Deletion attestation: after successful delivery and your confirmation of receipt, we will run a certified purge job for data not under legal hold and produce a signed deletion attestation that includes: deletion job id, timestamp (UTC), list of affected log file object keys, and tombstone markers for records logically removed.
- Legal hold: if Acme places records on legal hold prior to the export window end, those objects will be retained and excluded from purge workflows; we will flag them in the manifest and include the hold reason and hold id.

Operational prerequisites
- Provide the S3 bucket ARN and KMS key policy or a secure upload endpoint.
- Confirm a single technical contact and PO (if procurement required for accelerated turnaround).
- For redaction requests: share a superset of redaction criteria and a contact for the on-site redaction team; Redwood can perform automated token redaction for common PII patterns but does not perform manual redaction without a scoped SOW.

Next steps
1) Send the S3 details and confirm whether you want us to push to your bucket or provide presigned PUTs.
2) We will open INF-4921 (internal JIRA) and schedule the export snapshot.
3) Delivery manifest, SHA256 checksums, and signed export attestation will be provided as part of the package. Deletion attestation will follow 48–72 hours after you confirm receipt (unless legal hold is asserted).

If this plan looks good I'll schedule a short run-through call with Laura and Marissa to walk the packaging and attestation documents.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
